mechanism: Ethinyl estradiol may increase guanfacine levels through inhibition of hepatic metabolism and enterohepatic recirculation enhancement, while guanfacine may potentiate estrogen-related cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and for signs of guanfacine toxicity (sedation, dizziness, dry mouth); consider alternative antihypertensive if excessive hypotension develops; counsel on consistent dosing timing.
